EmergencyContact.title: EmergencyContact
EmergencyContact.description: Emergency contact registered for student emergency notifications and rescue dispatch.

id.description: Unique identifier of the contact record.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID or user identifier of the student.

name.description: Full name of the contact person.

relation.description: Relationship with the student (e.g. Father, Mother, Guardian, Warden).

phone.description: Mobile phone number for SMS and phone dispatch.

email.description: Optional email address of the emergency contact.

isPrimary.description: Whether this contact is marked as the primary first-responder.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the contact was added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the contact was last modified.

SosAlertHistory.title: SosAlertHistory
SosAlertHistory.description: Historical incident record of an SOS emergency alert or safe check-in event.

id.description: Unique incident ID for the alert event.

userId.description: User ID of the student who triggered the alert.

studentName.description: Full name of the student in need of assistance.

studentClass.description: Class or department of the student.

bloodGroup.description: Student blood group for medical dispatch.

triggerType.description: Nature and severity level of the alert.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident.

latitude.description: GPS latitude coordinates of the incident.

longitude.description: GPS longitude coordinates of the incident.

address.description: Geocoded address or physical landmark description.

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved or cancelled.

resolutionNotes.description: Debrief or resolution notes provided upon cancellation or rescue.

contactsNotifiedCount.description: Total number of registered emergency contacts notified.

/users/{userId}/emergency_contacts/{cont.description: User-owned list of emergency contacts notified during critical events.

/users/{userId}/sos_history/{alertId}.description: Per-user historical log of triggered SOS alerts and status resolutions.

/sos_alerts/{alertId}.description: Central emergency dispatch stream accessed by campus security, faculty, and admins.
